results.acceptance: The actual browser selects a C20-generated C19 passport, displays release, claimed policy and evidence details, and reports viewer assessment as unverified. The C21 test observed no non-GET request after selection; source uses FileReader and contains no upload path.
results.negative_cases: Empty, malformed, unsupported, duplicate-reference and over-limit inputs produce explicit errors. Cancel reading is keyboard-operable and prevents a delayed result from appearing. HTML-like warning text remains inert. Engine 503 is visibly unavailable while local viewing remains usable. The page stays within 360px.
results.security: Bounded parser rejects hostile JSON keys, excessive size and complexity; React text rendering does not execute selected source. No API, database, protected file or new dependency changed.
results.regression: Existing workspace browser tests passed together with C21; complete Go suite, vet and build passed.
results.quality: Pinned npm check passed: roadmap, TypeScript, production build and all 28 Node tests. The repository has no separate lint script; go vet and build passed. After the Noto Sans-first system font stack change, npm check and all 10 browser tests passed; no standalone lint script exists.
results.typography: Body, headings and UI controls retain one shared sans-serif family. Noto Sans is preferred when available, with native UI/system sans-serif fallback; no font asset or network request was added.
